skills.name: Structural data audit
skills.description: Establish table grain, key integrity, missingness, units, ranges, and leakage risks before mathematical modeling.

exclusions: Do not infer semantic equality from similar column names without checking values and units.

inputs.name: Table metadata
inputs.description: Rows, columns, types, samples, missingness, and candidate identifiers.

inputs.name: Problem constraints
inputs.description: Definitions, units, time scope, and entity scope from the task.

procedure.action: State the grain of every table and identify candidate keys.
procedure.purpose: Prevent invalid joins and duplicated observations.

procedure.action: Measure missingness, duplicates, ranges, units, and impossible values.
procedure.purpose: Turn data defects into explicit modeling decisions.

procedure.action: Check whether any feature uses information unavailable at prediction or decision time.

outputs.name: Data audit
outputs.description: A defect table with severity, affected fields, evidence, and treatment.

outputs.name: Model-ready schema
outputs.description: Declared grain, keys, units, roles, and exclusions.

validation_requirements.name: Row accounting
validation_requirements.description: Report row counts before and after every join, filter, and deduplication.

validation_requirements.name: Key checks
validation_requirements.description: Quantify duplicate and unmatched key rates.

skills.name: Time-aware feature engineering
skills.description: Create lag, rolling, seasonal, and calendar features using only information available before each target time.

exclusions: Do not use centered windows or future-filled values for predictive evaluation.

inputs.name: Ordered observations
inputs.description: A dataset with a validated time field and stable entity grain.

inputs.name: Forecast horizon
inputs.description: The lead time between available inputs and the predicted outcome.

procedure.action: Sort within entity and define a cutoff for every target row.
Generate lag, trailing-window, seasonal, and calendar candidates.
Fit all imputers and scalers inside each training fold.
procedure.purpose: Keep validation free of preprocessing leakage.

outputs.name: Feature matrix
outputs.description: Model inputs with definitions, availability times, and missingness rules.

outputs.name: Feature lineage
outputs.description: Source columns and transformations for each derived feature.

validation_requirements.name: Cutoff test
validation_requirements.description: Assert every feature timestamp is no later than its row cutoff.

validation_requirements.name: Ablation
validation_requirements.description: Compare the feature set with a simple baseline and report out-of-sample change.

skills.name: Baseline-to-candidate modeling
skills.description: Start with an interpretable baseline, add justified candidate models, and select using task-aligned performance plus constraint checks.

exclusions: Do not choose a complex model solely from in-sample fit.

inputs.name: Model-ready data
inputs.description: Audited observations, targets, features, and constraints.

inputs.name: Decision metric
inputs.description: A metric tied to the problem objective and error costs.

procedure.action: Fit a naive or simple interpretable baseline.
procedure.purpose: Create a minimum performance and sanity reference.

procedure.action: Fit a small set of candidates with explicit assumptions.
procedure.purpose: Compare mechanisms rather than search indiscriminately.

procedure.action: Select using held-out performance, stability, feasibility, and interpretability.
procedure.purpose: Align the chosen model with the actual decision.

outputs.name: Model comparison
outputs.description: Baseline and candidates with metrics, uncertainty, assumptions, and costs.

outputs.name: Selected model
outputs.description: The chosen formulation, parameters, and selection rationale.

validation_requirements.name: Baseline comparison
validation_requirements.description: Show that the selected model improves the task metric over the baseline.

validation_requirements.name: Constraint verification
validation_requirements.description: Check predictions or decisions against required physical and business constraints.

skills.name: Structure-preserving validation
skills.description: Choose validation splits that preserve temporal, grouped, or spatial dependence and keep preprocessing inside training folds.

exclusions: Do not use unrestricted random row splits when observations share time, entity, or location dependence.

inputs.name: Dependency structure
inputs.description: Time, group, spatial, and repeated-measure identifiers.

inputs.name: Candidate pipeline
inputs.description: Preprocessing, feature creation, fitting, and prediction steps.

procedure.action: Select rolling, grouped, blocked, or nested splits that match deployment.
procedure.purpose: Estimate performance under realistic information boundaries.

procedure.action: Refit the full pipeline separately in every fold.
Report fold-level errors and residual diagnostics.
procedure.purpose: Expose instability hidden by an average metric.

outputs.name: Validation design
outputs.description: Split logic, fold membership, metric definitions, and leakage controls.

outputs.name: Out-of-sample results
outputs.description: Aggregate and fold-level metrics with residual checks.

validation_requirements.name: Split integrity
validation_requirements.description: Assert forbidden time, group, or spatial overlap is zero.

validation_requirements.name: Error distribution
validation_requirements.description: Report variation across folds or backtest windows, not only the mean.

skills.name: Assumption sensitivity analysis
skills.description: Vary uncertain inputs, modeling assumptions, and decision thresholds to identify which conclusions are stable.

exclusions: Do not vary one parameter while silently refitting or changing unrelated assumptions.

inputs.name: Reference model
inputs.description: A validated model and its baseline assumptions.

inputs.name: Uncertain factors
inputs.description: Plausible ranges or scenarios for inputs, parameters, and thresholds.

procedure.action: Rank assumptions by uncertainty and decision relevance.
Run controlled one-at-a-time and joint scenario changes.
Track metric and decision changes relative to the reference model.

outputs.name: Sensitivity matrix
outputs.description: Scenario inputs, performance changes, decision changes, and rank stability.

outputs.name: Robustness statement
outputs.description: Stable conclusions, fragile conclusions, and breakpoints.

validation_requirements.name: Range justification
validation_requirements.description: Tie every tested range to observed data, domain constraints, or an explicit scenario.

validation_requirements.name: Decision stability
validation_requirements.description: Report whether recommendations, rankings, or feasibility change across scenarios.

skills.name: Claim-evidence result organization
skills.description: Organize each conclusion as a claim linked to a metric, figure or table, uncertainty, assumptions, and decision implication.

exclusions: Do not present historical case findings as results of the current analysis.

inputs.name: Validated results
inputs.description: Metrics, diagnostics, sensitivity results, figures, and model assumptions.

inputs.name: Decision questions
inputs.description: The questions and constraints the final answer must resolve.

procedure.action: State each decision-relevant claim in one testable sentence.
procedure.purpose: Separate conclusions from background and method description.

procedure.action: Attach current-run evidence, uncertainty, and assumptions to every claim.
End with recommendations, limitations, and next checks.

outputs.name: Claim-evidence table
outputs.description: Claims linked to current-run artifacts, uncertainty, assumptions, and implications.

outputs.name: Decision summary
outputs.description: Recommendations with confidence and explicit limitations.

validation_requirements.name: Evidence coverage
validation_requirements.description: Every major claim cites at least one current-run metric, table, or figure.

validation_requirements.name: Scope check
validation_requirements.description: Clearly distinguish current results, historical method inspiration, and unresolved assumptions.
